description_en: Queries the details of an ApsaraDB RDS instance
description_zh: 该接口用于查询RDS实例的详细信息
kebab_example: aliyun rds describe-db-instance-attribute --db-instance-id rm-uf6wjk50000 --expired False --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeDBInstanceAttribute

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the instance. Call the DescribeDBInstances operation to query instance IDs.
<warning>Do not specify multiple instance IDs in a single request. This may cause the query to time out.></warning>
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。可调用DescribeDBInstances获取。
<warning>请勿同时配置多个实例ID进行批量查询，否则将会查询超时导致失败。></warning>
parameters.name: db_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
Indicates whether the instance is expired. Valid values:

True: The instance is expired.

False: The instance is not expired
parameters.help_zh:
实例过期状态。取值：

True：已过期。
False：未过期
parameters.name: expired

schema.description_en: The details of the returned parameters

DBInstanceAttribute.description_en: An array that consists of the attributes of the instance

items.description_en: The details of the instance attributes

AccountMaxQuantity.description_en: The maximum number of accounts that can be created on the instance
AccountMaxQuantity.description_zh: 可创建账号的最大数量

AdvancedFeatures.description_en:
This parameter is returned only for an RDS for SQL Server instance. It indicates the advanced features that are enabled. If multiple advanced features are enabled, the features are separated by commas (,). Valid values:

LinkedServer: linked server

DistributeTransaction: distributed transaction
AdvancedFeatures.description_zh:
目前只针对SQL Server，获取高级特性值，多个值之间用半角逗号（,）隔开。返回值：
LinkedServer：链接服务器。
DistributeTransaction：分布式事务

AutoUpgradeMinorVersion.description_en:
The update method for the minor engine version. Valid values:

Auto: The minor engine version is automatically updated.

Manual: The minor engine version is not automatically updated. You must manually update the minor engine version
AutoUpgradeMinorVersion.description_zh:
实例升级小版本的方式。返回值：
Auto：自动升级小版本。
Manual：不自动升级，仅在当前版本下线时才强制升级

AvailabilityValue.description_en: The service availability of the instance in percentages
AvailabilityValue.description_zh: 实例可用性状态，单位：百分比（%）

BabelfishConfig.description_en: The configuration of [Babelfish for ApsaraDB RDS for PostgreSQL]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/428613.html）

BabelfishEnabled.description_en:
Indicates whether Babelfish is enabled.

If you enable Babelfish when you create an ApsaraDB RDS for PostgreSQL instance, this parameter is always true
BabelfishEnabled.description_zh:
Babelfish开关。
购买RDS PostgreSQL实例时，如果开启了Babelfish，则此参数固定为true

MigrationMode.description_en:
The [migration mode]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/428613.html） for Babelfish. Valid values:

single-db: single-database mode

multi-db: multi-database mode
MigrationMode.description_zh:
Babelfish[迁移模式]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/428613.html）。返回值：
single-db：单数据库模式。
multi-db：多数据库模式

BurstingEnabled.description_en:
Indicates whether the [performance burst]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2340501.html） feature is enabled for the ESSD. Valid values:

true: The feature is enabled.

false: The feature is disabled
BurstingEnabled.description_zh:
[高性能云盘]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2340501.html）的IO性能突发功能开关。取值：
true：开启。
false：关闭

CanTempUpgrade.description_en:
Indicates whether the instance is eligible for a temporary upgrade.

This feature is not supported for pay-as-you-go instances
CanTempUpgrade.description_zh:
是否满足临时升级条件。
按量付费实例不支持临时升级

Category.description_en:
The instance edition. Valid values:

Basic: Basic Edition

HighAvailability: High-availability Edition

cluster: Cluster Edition for ApsaraDB RDS for MySQL

AlwaysOn: Cluster Edition for ApsaraDB RDS for SQL Server

Finance: Enterprise Edition

Serverless_basic: Serverless Basic Edition
Category.description_zh:
实例系列。返回值：
Basic：基础系列
HighAvailability：高可用系列
cluster：MySQL集群系列
AlwaysOn：SQL Server集群系列
Finance：三节点企业系列
Serverless_basic：Serverless基础系列

ColdDataEnabled.description_en:
Indicates whether the [data archiving]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2701832.html） feature is enabled for the ESSD. Valid values:

true: The feature is enabled.

false: The feature is disabled
ColdDataEnabled.description_zh:
高性能云盘[数据归档]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2701832.html）功能开关。返回值：

true：开启。
false：关闭

CompressionMode.description_en: The storage compression mode. Valid values: on and off

ConnectionMode.description_en:
The connection mode of the instance. Valid values:

Standard: standard connection mode

Safe: database proxy mode
ConnectionMode.description_zh:
实例的访问模式。返回值：
Standard：标准访问模式。
Safe：数据库代理模式

ConsoleVersion.description_en:
The type of the database proxy. Valid values:

1: shared database proxy

2: dedicated database proxy

We recommend that you use the ProxyType parameter instead
ConsoleVersion.description_zh:
实例的代理类型。返回值：
1：共享代理。
2：独享代理。

不建议使用该参数，请使用返回参数ProxyType

CreationTime.description_en: The time when the instance was created. The time is in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time is displayed in UTC

CurrentKernelVersion.description_en: The minor engine version of the instance

DBClusterNode.description_en: The details of the nodes in the cluster

ClassCode.description_en: The instance type of the node

ClassType.description_en:
The instance family of the node. Valid values:

d: dedicated

x: general-purpose
ClassType.description_zh:
节点规格类型。返回值：
d：独享规格
x：通用规格

Cpu.description_en: The number of CPU cores of the node

Memory.description_en: The memory size of the node. Unit: MB

NodeRole.description_en:
The role of the node. Valid values:

primary: primary node

secondary: secondary node
NodeRole.description_zh:
节点角色。返回值：

primary：主节点
secondary：备节点

Status.description_en:
The state of the node. Valid values:

active

creating

deleting

classchanging

restarting
Status.description_zh:
节点的状态。返回值：
active
creating
deleting
classchanging
restarting

DBInstanceClass.description_en: The instance type. For more information, see [Instance types]()
DBInstanceClass.description_zh: 实例规格，详情请参见[实例规格表]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/26312.html）

DBInstanceClassType.description_en:
The instance family. Valid values:

s: shared

x: general-purpose

d: dedicated

h: dedicated host
DBInstanceClassType.description_zh:
实例规格族。返回值：

s：共享型。
x：通用型。
d：独享套餐。
h：独占物理机

DBInstanceDiskUsed.description_en:
The used storage space of the instance. Unit: bytes.

<notice>

For a serverless ApsaraDB RDS for MySQL instance, this parameter returns 0 if the instance is stopped.

</notice>
DBInstanceDiskUsed.description_zh:
实例的磁盘使用量，单位：byte。

<notice>对于RDS MySQL Serverless实例，当实例状态为已暂停（Stopped）时，该参数返回值为0。></notice>

DBInstanceMemory.description_en: The memory size of the instance. Unit: MB

DBInstanceNetType.description_en:
The network type of the instance. Valid values:

Internet: The instance is connected over the Internet.

Intranet: The instance is connected over the internal network
DBInstanceNetType.description_zh:
实例是内网或外网。返回值：

Internet：外网。
Intranet：内网

DBInstanceStatus.description_en: The state of the instance. For more information, see [Instance states]()
DBInstanceStatus.description_zh: 实例状态，详情请参见[实例状态表]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/26315.html）

DBInstanceStorage.description_en: The total storage space of the instance. Unit: GB

DBInstanceStorageType.description_en:
The storage type of the instance. Valid values:

local_ssd and ephemeral_ssd: local SSDs

cloud_ssd: standard SSDs

general_essd: general-purpose ESSDs

cloud_essd0: PL0 ESSDs

cloud_essd: PL1 ESSDs

cloud_essd2: PL2 ESSDs

cloud_essd3: PL3 ESSDs
DBInstanceStorageType.description_zh:
实例储存类型。返回值：

local_ssd、ephemeral_ssd：高性能本地盘。
cloud_ssd：SSD云盘。
general_essd：高性能云盘。
cloud_essd0：ESSD PL0云盘。
cloud_essd：ESSD PL1云盘。
cloud_essd2：ESSD PL2云盘。
cloud_essd3：ESSD PL3云盘

DBInstanceType.description_en:
The role of the instance. Valid values:

Primary: primary instance

Readonly: read-only instance

Guard: disaster recovery instance

Temp: temporary instance
DBInstanceType.description_zh:
实例类型。返回值：

Primary：主实例。
Readonly：只读实例。
Guard：灾备实例。
Temp：临时实例

DBMaxQuantity.description_en: The maximum number of databases that can be created on the instance
DBMaxQuantity.description_zh: 一个实例下可创建最大数据库数量

DeletionProtection.description_en:
Indicates whether release protection is enabled. Valid values:

true: The feature is enabled.

false: The feature is disabled
DeletionProtection.description_zh:
是否已开启释放保护功能。返回值：
true：已开启。
false：未开启

DisasterRecoveryInfo.description_en: The details of the disaster recovery source instance

DisasterRecoveryInstances.description_en: The disaster recovery instances of the current instance
DisasterRecoveryInstances.description_zh: 当前实例的所有灾备实例

Engine.description_en:
The database engine. Valid values:

MySQL

PostgreSQL

SQLServer

MariaDB
Engine.description_zh:
数据库类型。返回值：

MySQL
PostgreSQL
SQLServer
MariaDB

ExpireTime.description_en:
The time when the subscription instance expires. The time is in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time is displayed in UTC.

This parameter is not returned for pay-as-you-go instances
ExpireTime.description_zh: 到期时间。格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）。 按量付费实例无到期时间

Extra.description_en: The extended information about the instance

AccountSecurityPolicy.description_en:
The password policy for database accounts. Valid values:

MaximumPasswordAge: the maximum password age

MinimumPasswordAge: the minimum password age
AccountSecurityPolicy.description_zh:
数据库账号的密码策略。返回值：
MaximumPasswordAge：密码的最长使用时间
MinimumPasswordAge：密码的最短使用时间

DBInstanceId.description_en: The list of database instance IDs

RecoveryModel.example:
Simple：简单恢复模式。
Full：完整恢复模式。

GeneralGroupName.description_en: The name of the dedicated cluster to which the ApsaraDB MyBase for MySQL instance belongs
GeneralGroupName.description_zh: 专属集群MySQL通用版实例所属的组名

GuardDBInstanceId.description_en: The ID of the disaster recovery instance that is attached to the instance
GuardDBInstanceId.description_zh: 该实例如果挂载着灾备实例，即为灾备实例的ID

IPType.description_en: The IP address type. Only IPv4 is supported

IncrementSourceDBInstanceId.description_en: The ID of the source instance for incremental data synchronization. This parameter is returned for read-only instances and disaster recovery instances. If this parameter is not returned, the instance is a primary instance
IncrementSourceDBInstanceId.description_zh: 增量数据来源的实例ID，例如灾备实例的增量数据来源是主实例。只读实例的增量数据来源是主实例，如果没有返回此参数则表示该实例是主实例

InstanceNetworkType.description_en:
The network type of the instance. Valid values:

Classic: classic network

VPC: virtual private cloud (VPC)
InstanceNetworkType.description_zh:
实例的网络类型。返回值：
Classic：经典网络。
VPC：专有网络

InstructionSetArch.description_en:
The CPU architecture of the instance. Valid values:

x86

arm
InstructionSetArch.description_zh:
实例的架构类型。返回值：

x86
arm

IoAccelerationEnabled.description_en:
Indicates whether the [Buffer Pool Extension (BPE)]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2527067.html） feature is enabled for the ESSD. Valid values:

1: The feature is enabled.

0: The feature is disabled
IoAccelerationEnabled.description_zh:
高性能云盘的[Buffer Pool Extension（BPE）]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2527067.html）功能开关。返回值：

1：开启
0：不开启

IsAnalyticReadOnlyIns.description_en:
Indicates whether the instance is a [MySQL DuckDB analytic instance]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2950002.html）. Valid values:

true: The instance is a MySQL DuckDB analytic instance.

false: The instance is not a MySQL DuckDB analytic instance
IsAnalyticReadOnlyIns.description_zh:
实例是否属于[MySQL DuckDB分析实例]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2950002.html）。返回值：

true：是
false：否

LatestKernelVersion.description_en: The latest kernel version supported by the instance
LatestKernelVersion.description_zh: 当前实例支持的最新内核版本

LockMode.description_en:
The lock state of the instance. Valid values:

Unlock: The instance is not locked.

ManualLock: The instance is manually locked.

LockByExpiration: The instance is automatically locked after it expires.

LockByRestoration: The instance is automatically locked before a rollback.

LockByDiskQuota: The instance is automatically locked after its storage is full.

LockReadInstanceByDiskQuota: The read-only instance is automatically locked after its storage is full
LockMode.description_zh:
实例锁定模式。返回值：
Unlock：正常。
ManualLock：手动触发锁定。
LockByExpiration：实例过期自动锁定。
LockByRestoration：实例回滚前的自动锁定。
LockByDiskQuota：实例空间满自动锁定。
LockReadInstanceByDiskQuota：只读实例空间满自动锁定

LockReason.description_en: The reason why the instance is locked

MaintainTime.description_en: The maintenance window. The time is in the \`HH:mmZ-HH:mmZ\` format and is displayed in UTC. For example, a value of \`00:00Z-02:00Z\` indicates that the instance can be maintained from 08:00 to 10:00 (UTC+8)
MaintainTime.description_zh: 实例可维护时间段，表示为UTC时间，+8小时后是控制台上显示到的可维护时间段

MasterInstanceId.description_en:
The ID of the primary instance.

If this parameter is not returned, the current instance is the primary instance
MasterInstanceId.description_zh:
主实例的ID。

如果没有返回此参数则表示该实例是主实例

MasterZone.description_en: The ID of the primary zone

MaxConnections.description_en: The maximum number of concurrent connections

MaxIOMBPS.description_en: The maximum I/O throughput. Unit: MB/s

MultipleTempUpgrade.description_en: Indicates whether the instance is undergoing a temporary upgrade. This parameter is returned only if the instance is undergoing a temporary upgrade
MultipleTempUpgrade.description_zh: 实例是否正在进行弹性变配。返回true表示当前正在进行弹性变配，若未进行，则不返回该参数值

OptimizedWritesInfo.description_en:
Information about the 16 KB atomic write feature. The value is a JSON string that contains the following fields:

optimized_writes: Indicates whether the feature is enabled.

init_optimized_writes: Indicates whether the feature can be enabled
OptimizedWritesInfo.description_zh:
OptimizedWritesInfo包含两个字段：

optimized_writes：当前实例是否开启了16K原子写。

init_optimized_writes：实例能否开启16K原子写。部分实例因为init_optimized_writes为false不在控制台展示16K原子写开关

PGBouncerEnabled.description_en:
Indicates whether PgBouncer is enabled.

This parameter is returned only for ApsaraDB RDS for PostgreSQL instances
PGBouncerEnabled.description_zh:
PgBouncer开关。
仅PostgreSQL实例返回此参数，如果开启了PgBouncer，则此参数返回值为true

PayType.description_en:
The billing method of the instance. Valid values:

Postpaid: pay-as-you-go

Prepaid: subscription

SERVERLESS: serverless
PayType.description_zh:
实例付费方式。返回值：

Postpaid：按量付费。
Prepaid：包年包月。
SERVERLESS：Serverless

Port.description_en: The port that is used to connect to the instance over an internal network

ProxyType.description_en:
The type of database proxy that the instance supports. Valid values:

0: The instance does not support database proxies.

1: The instance supports shared database proxies.

2: The instance supports dedicated database proxies
ProxyType.description_zh:
实例支持的代理类型。返回值：

0：不支持开通代理。
1：支持开通共享代理（多租户模式）。
2：支持开通独享代理（单租户模式）

ReadOnlyDBInstanceId.description_en: An array that consists of the IDs of the read-only instances that are attached to the primary instance
ReadOnlyDBInstanceId.description_zh: 主实例下挂载的只读实例ID列表

items.description_en: The details of the read-only instance

ReadonlyInstanceSQLDelayedTime.description_en: The data replication latency between the primary and read-only instances. Unit: seconds
ReadonlyInstanceSQLDelayedTime.description_zh: 只读实例延迟复制时间，只读实例延迟ReadonlyInstanceSQLDelayedTime的时间后再同步主实例数据，单位：秒（s）

ResourceGroupId.description_en: The ID of the resource group

SecurityIPList.description_en: The IP addresses in the whitelist

SecurityIPMode.description_en:
The whitelist mode of the instance. Valid values:

normal: standard whitelist mode

safety: enhanced whitelist mode
SecurityIPMode.description_zh:
白名单模式。返回值：
normal：通用模式。
safety：高安全模式

ServerlessConfig.description_en: The configurations of the serverless instance

AutoPause.description_en:
Indicates whether the auto-pause feature is enabled for the serverless instance. Valid values:

true: The feature is enabled.

false (default): The feature is disabled.

If no connections are established to the instance within 10 minutes, the instance is paused. The instance automatically resumes when a connection is established
AutoPause.description_zh:
是否开启Serverless实例的自动启停功能。返回值：

true：启用。
false：不启用，默认值。

10分钟无任何连接将进入暂停状态，连接时会自动唤醒

ScaleMax.description_en: The maximum number of RDS Capacity Units (RCUs)
ScaleMax.description_zh: 实例RCU（RDS Capacity Unit）自动扩缩范围的最大值

ScaleMin.description_en: The minimum number of RDS Capacity Units (RCUs)
ScaleMin.description_zh: 实例RCU（RDS Capacity Unit）自动扩缩范围的最小值

SwitchForce.description_en:
Indicates whether the force-scaling feature is enabled for the serverless instance. Valid values:

true: The feature is enabled.

false (default): The feature is disabled.

RCU scaling for an instance usually takes effect immediately. In rare cases, the scaling may fail. If a scaling fails, you can enable this feature to forcibly scale the RCUs of the instance
SwitchForce.description_zh:
是否开启Serverless实例的强制弹性扩缩容。返回值：

true：启用。
false：不启用，默认值。

实例RCU的弹性扩缩容通常会立刻生效，但在某些特殊情况下无法即时完成扩缩容，此时可开启本参数进行强制扩缩容

SlaveZone.description_en: The details of the secondary zone

SuperPermissionMode.description_en:
Indicates whether the instance supports features such as privileged accounts, Active Directory (AD) authentication, and host accounts. Valid values:

Enable: The instance supports the features.

Disabled: The instance does not support the features
SuperPermissionMode.description_zh:
当前实例是否可以开放SA账号、AD域、主机账号等高权限功能。返回值：
Enable：开放。
Disabled：不开放

SupportCompression.description_en: Indicates whether the instance supports storage compression
SupportCompression.description_zh: 实例是否支持开启存储压缩

TempDBInstanceId.description_en: The ID of the temporary instance that is attached to the instance
TempDBInstanceId.description_zh: 该实例如果挂载着临时实例，即为临时实例ID

TempUpgradeTimeEnd.description_en:
The end time of the temporary upgrade.

This parameter is not returned for pay-as-you-go instances
TempUpgradeTimeEnd.description_zh:
实例临时升级结束时间。

按量付费实例无实例临时升级结束时间

TempUpgradeTimeStart.description_en:
The start time of the temporary upgrade.

This parameter is not returned for pay-as-you-go instances
TempUpgradeTimeStart.description_zh:
实例临时升级开始时间。

按量付费实例无实例临时升级开始时间

TimeZone.description_en: The time zone of the instance

Tips.description_en: Information about an exception that is detected on a general-purpose ApsaraDB MyBase for MySQL instance
Tips.description_zh: 专属集群MySQL通用版实例的异常提示信息

TipsLevel.description_en:
The severity of the exception that is detected on a general-purpose ApsaraDB MyBase for MySQL instance. Valid values:

1: Normal

2: The specifications of the read-only instance and the primary instance are different. This may affect the availability of the instance. Adjust the specifications of the instance as needed
TipsLevel.description_zh:
专属集群MySQL通用版实例的异常提示等级。返回值：
1：正常。
2：只读实例和主实例规格不对齐，可能影响可用性，请按需调整实例规格

kindCode.description_en: An internal parameter. You do not need to specify this parameter
